card.name: People nouns after his/her/its/their
card.fires_on: Nouns for people or groups (people, children, wives, siblings, wife) right after a possessive like his, its or their. Also fires on a comma or 'more' in the same slot.

modes.label: Possessed people noun
modes.description: A word for kin or subordinates right after a possessive.
modes.example: but also of his own<< people>> for as long as he was in power

modes.label: Comparative after possessive
modes.description: The word 'more' after its or his, before an adjective describing others.
modes.example: displaced on the throne by his<< more>> militant son, Selim I.

modes.label: Comma in a list of persons
modes.description: A comma after a person named with a possessive, before another person.
modes.example: betrayed by Olga, his girlfriend<<,>> and Onegin.

card.writes: No clear meaning from the promoted tokens; they are mixed and unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up when a sentence is about someone's own people, such as his children, wife or siblings.
